notes.title: 1.0.1 patch
notes.notes: Hello everyone, this is a small patch that features some bug fixes as well as the option to keep levelling up past the max power level!

notes.title: Loot Grind Simulator is out NOW!
notes.notes:
Loot Grind Simulator has finally released!

Thank you for your patience these past few weeks, I spent months working on this game making it the biggest game I've made so far! I hope you will enjoy the finished product and can't wait to hear your thoughts!
